method.scope: Bounded to the top 20 token accounts for each of 3,987 current Jupiter verified-registry mints; not an exhaustive token-account census.
method.mapping: Observed off-curve token authority -> authority account owner -> current executable; recent successful outbound inner SPL transfer separately identifies the invoking signer program.
method.value: grossUsd uses registry price without liquidity validation. credibleUsd only includes strict, stable, or LST-tagged assets and remains a prioritization estimate, not exploitable value.
method.exclusions: Native/System/Token/Token-2022/ATA/loaders and programs already in the existing high-value queue are excluded from this long-tail queue.
method.score: 0-45 credible custody, 0-15 deployment recency, 0-15 manually assessed source/IDL sparsity, 0-25 sampled recent outbound signer activity.
limitations: Below-top-20 token accounts, mints absent from the registry, native SOL/stake, and compressed tokens are outside this census.
Absence of a sampled outflow is not evidence that no withdrawal path exists.
Program-owned authority state is not treated as control proof unless outbound invoke-signer evidence joins it to a parent program.
Custody, locked allocations, bridge liquidity, and protocol TVL are not equivalent to an exploitable amount.

annotation.notes: Exact-program-id search did not locate an authoritative identity, source tree, or IDL. Do not infer that the jup prefix makes this an official Jupiter program.
